title: Comparative dossier re-review
summary: Re-review all twelve comparison passports against the new chronicles and ledgers while preserving Context only.
record_scope: Comparative dossier re-review records governed by the stated publication boundaries.
publication_boundaries: AI-assisted source triage can map exact artifacts and expose their limits, but it cannot stand in for the repository's required human admissibility decision.
A source-check receipt proves only that the named official artifact was inspected on the stated date; it does not admit the artifact, satisfy a requirement, or answer a mission.
No project stage, place state, comparison verdict, observation, outcome, score, rank, causal finding, recommendation, or future Phase 60 decision is created.
A repository-bounded gap says what this reviewed corpus has not established; it never asserts that qualifying evidence does not exist elsewhere.

comparison_reviews.title: Compute, power and water
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: The files can be compared as evidence chains: named demand, public authority, infrastructure commitment, implementation milestone and the still-missing accepted-service record.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Power demand, wafer output, water use and economic value use different entities, periods and denominators; they cannot be normalized into a project-performance comparison.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Facility-specific accepted utility service, commissioning, qualification, customer acceptance and repeated output records with stable denominators.

comparison_reviews.title: Permission is not operation
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: Each file exposes the boundary between permission or commitment and a later receiving-system event.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Different legal instruments do not confer equivalent authority, and an approved land-use file cannot be compared as performance with a mine, launch site or semiconductor facility.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: The next case-specific enactment, condition-clearance, permit, inspection, commissioning, acceptance or recurring-operation artifact named in each Atlas file.

comparison_reviews.title: Standards to adoption
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: The cases can be read against a common adoption chain from rule or framework to an identified receiving system and observable implementation event.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Cryptographic migration, assurance evaluation, broadband adoption and autonomous service have incompatible units and acceptance authorities.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Stable inventories, named receiving organizations, acceptance criteria, dated cutovers and repeated-use records that distinguish availability from adoption.

comparison_reviews.title: Autonomous service and public accountability
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: Both files connect public authority to a named passenger-facing service and expose the additional records needed to evaluate access and reliability.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Autonomous-vehicle miles and accessible-station delivery are different service units and must not be collapsed into one mobility score.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Repeated service, accessibility, complaint, incident and exposure series with stable geography, fleet or station identities and revision notes.

comparison_reviews.title: Research to assurance
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: The cases share a progression from technical framework to institutional use, with explicit separation between evaluation, authorization and operation.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Test results, procurement actions, migration progress and service outcomes are distinct claim types and cannot substitute for one another.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Receiving-institution acceptance, deployed configuration, monitoring, exception handling and repeated mission-use records tied to the evaluated system.

comparison_reviews.title: Minerals to manufacturing
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: The selected files can be compared as conversion sequences from financed or permitted capacity to qualified, receiver-visible production.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Mineral tonnes, semiconductor wafers and component output are not compatible denominators and do not support a cross-industry productivity ranking.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Named commissioning and process-qualification records, customer acceptance, repeat lots or units, yield and delivery data, and disclosed interruptions.

comparison_reviews.title: Space capacity to mission cadence
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: Each case distinguishes a capacity-enabling milestone from later mission or readiness evidence.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Launch cadence, aircraft delivery and fleet availability have different assets, missions, periods and denominators.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Named asset acceptance, range or base availability, repeat mission records, downtime and exception reporting for a stable cohort and period.

comparison_reviews.title: Housing and infrastructure conversion
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: The files reveal how local authority and infrastructure conditions create sequential delivery gates.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Dwelling units, data-center load and fab capacity cannot be compared as equivalent outputs, and regional aggregates cannot stand in for project delivery.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Enacted instruments, cleared conditions, permits, completed servicing, inspections, occupancy or accepted facility-service records at the named site.

comparison_reviews.title: Climate, water and industrial resilience
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: The cases can be checked for whether hazard, water, safety and operating boundaries are named at the same asset or receiving system.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Hazard projections, water agreements, safety events and production performance describe different phenomena and cannot be blended into a resilience score.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Compatible site-level resource use, hazard exposure, interruption, recovery and repeated-operation measures with asset identities and revision history.

comparison_reviews.title: Workforce to qualified capacity
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: The records can be compared for the presence or absence of links between workforce preparation and receiver-accepted output.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Graduates, jobs, headcount, units delivered and availability are not interchangeable measures of capacity.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Role-level qualification, placement and retention joined to line qualification, accepted output, yield and delivery cadence for the same facility and period.

comparison_reviews.title: Finance, risk and infrastructure
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: The cases show where financial commitment sits within a longer infrastructure-delivery chain.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Loan values, utility investments, storage capacities and service obligations use different boundaries and cannot support a return or project-quality ranking.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Financial close or obligation joined to expenditure, physical completion, acceptance, service, operating performance and disclosed risk allocation.

comparison_reviews.title: Observation to outcome
comparison_reviews.identity_test: Passed for exact joins; entities remain non-equivalent.
comparison_reviews.what_is_comparable: The files can be compared as examples of how evidence advances—or stops—between a dated observation and an outcome claim.
comparison_reviews.what_must_not_be_compared: Stations, waste batches, broadband locations, production units and evaluation results are deliberately non-equivalent outcome units.
comparison_reviews.decisive_next_evidence: Repeated compatible measures for stable entities and periods, documented revisions and uncertainty, and a bounded attribution design appropriate to the claim.
